Red Carpet
A private hospital room by the sea. Rajiv Kapoor, half his face still, eyes completely alive. His speech is slow. Every word costs him.
He shows you his nurse's phone. A bank transfer screenshot. Sushma Kapoor to a Vivaan Rai production company. Twenty lakh. The day before Part One.
Take the screenshot. Tell Tara tonight.
She deserves the truth.
Take it. Wait for the right moment.
The truth can wait a day.
Promise Rajiv you'll get him home to Tara.
And mean it.
Silver Screen Awards night. The red carpet. Six hundred photographers. Tara in emerald, holding your arm a little tighter than the photographers need.
Lovely. The fraud and the fraud's husband. Part Two drops tomorrow. It's the whole contract. Signatures and all.
Say it loudly, to the cameras: Sushma paid him.
Burn it all down.
Walk past him. Hold her hand.
Starve him of the moment.
Whisper: "Release it. I'll release mine."
Bluff.
Six hundred cameras hear it. Tara's face goes white. Not at Vivaan. At you. You told the country before you told her.
My mother? You knew? And you said it HERE?
Inside, between awards, she pulls you behind a pillar where there are no cameras.
Whatever happens tomorrow. Thank you for tonight.
She kisses you. Not for the cameras. There are no cameras. There's only the next award being announced too loudly.
Part Two drops tomorrow: the whole contract. And clause seven is already broken.
